chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-ʿArzamī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you catch the Imam on Friday and he has preceded you by one rakʿah, then add another rakʿah to it and recite aloud in it. And if you catch him while he is reciting the tashahhud, then pray four [rakʿahs].

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rakʿahs, meaning the prayer is performed as ẓuhr instead
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational prayer
key_terms.بِرَكْعَةٍ: by one rakʿah; one unit of the prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَةً أُخْرَى: another rakʿah added to complete the prayer
key_terms.وَاجْهَرْ: recite aloud, meaning audible recitation in the prayer
key_terms.يَتَشَهَّدُ: reciting the tashahhud in the sitting portion of salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, referring here to Jumuʿah prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he joins the Imam late on Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining the Imam in Jumuʿah prayer after part of it has already passed. If one catches one rakʿah, the prayer is completed as Jumuʿah with another rakʿah; but if one only catches the tashahhud, one must instead pray four rakʿahs.
